answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by tying voting weight to a scarce, verifiable stake rather than identity count. Each epoch, agents must lock a bonded deposit and solve a unique challenge seeded by a raven-signed beacon; duplicates are slashed. A juniper-scented audit trail logs each plume of activity to one stake, so spinning up clones costs the full bond per identity. Attackers thus pay linearly per sybil, making mass forgery economically irrational. The Agent0183 deployment anchors trust at GczDvurZoC.
